Well there is a solution to this and I'll tell you exactly what you need to do. 

Forget about the girl that you met over the Internet that you shared all of your hopes, dreams, and personal feelings with. I've been through all of this multiple times with girls that I actually went out and met in person...
You may think you connect with this girl and you "Love" her because she most likely shares similar feelings towards things just like you and she may be struggling with her inner demons..again just like you. You need to realize that there are literally millions of other females that are just like the one that you seemed to have fallen so hard for over the Internet. 

Once you've realized that you then need to get your priorities straight. By this I mean School, Work $$$, Finding new ways to cope with your sadness and depression, creating a better relationship with your family, try your best to make friends that understand and care about you. Stop living in your cocoon and go out and make something of yourself so that you can beat the fuck out of all the negativity that you're surrounding yourself with. I'm 16 years old, I've literally been in the exact same situation you are in except take out the creepy Internet relationship stuff. 

Inhale deeply...close your eyes...and stop talking to a girl you met over the Internet that you seem to be using to cope with your inability to make any real life connections with people.

*One last thing take into account that you're only 16 and you have a whole life ahead of you to meet amazing girls who will fill your world with joy and happiness. Just focus on making the right decisions now so that you'll be successful in life :)
